title: Why is Trump looking to China to help open the Strait of Hormuz?
summary: US president Donald Trump has called on numerous nations, including China, to help ships safely ‌transit the key Strait of Hormuz, where one-fifth of the world's oil transits on a daily basis. But why has Trump turned to Beijing, so often an adversary of the US and ally of Iran, for help? France 24's Olvier Farry takes a look.
